user_story:
As a user, I want to upload a file to the application so that I can manage my files effectively.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. The user can select a file using the input element with id 'file-upload'.
2. Upon clicking the upload button (input element with id 'file-submit'), the file is uploaded successfully.
3. The application navigates to the same URL ('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/upload') after the upload action.
4. A success message appears in the 'flash-messages' div with id 'flash-messages'.
